says: In today's version, L2 never reads the options the ACP adapter sends for a Claude turn: that path sends `claudeMetaOf(turn)`, not the harness's meta, and no test checks its `env`.
proof: adapter.ts:181 picks `claudeMetaOf(turn)` for claude; harness.run-as-node.laws.test.ts:137 and 155 read only `h.meta`, and builder-acp.run-as-node.laws.test.ts:112 reads only `builderHarness`'s meta. adapter.test.ts:23 reads only `systemPrompt` from `claudeMetaOf`.
cost: Dropping `env` in `claudeMetaOf` would hand the switch to the Claude CLI's commands on that path with every law green.
